model.title: Three Descents at Once
model.premise: A single gift descends through Strain, Distortion and Captivity inside itself. An archetype does not run one descent — it runs three, in parallel. All three gifts strain together, distort together, and go captive together. What makes an archetype's distress distinctive is never the order the gifts break in; the top three are a set, not a sequence. It is what the three descents produce when they combine.
model.note: None of this is a prediction that you will fail this way. It is a map of what your particular three gifts do to each other when they are all under load. The cheapest place to interrupt it is Strain, and Strain always looks like your gifts working properly — which is why the tell matters more than the theory.
model.missingPremise: Every archetype is three gifts, which means four gifts are quiet. Under pressure that matters more than usual: the check that would catch this combination lives in the gifts the archetype does not lead with. This is the single most useful reason to keep people around you who are not like you.
model.patternPremise: Some gifts aim their distress outward at people. Some bank it silently. Some conceal it and then leave. Which mix an archetype carries determines how its three descents synchronise — whether they compound, hide each other, or alternate.

apex-visionary.name: The Sealed Blueprint
apex-visionary.line: A complete design no one was allowed to shape, defended by someone who has stopped believing anyone could.

missing.text: Mercy is the brake this archetype does not have. A Lover registers that the room went quiet three meetings ago — the one datum that would have shown the model was losing the people it was built for.

stages.text: The vision acquires an edge, the evidence acquires caveats, and the plan acquires a tighter grip — all in the same week. Colleagues meet someone simultaneously more urgent, less forthcoming and less willing to delegate, and read it as a door closing while the demands rise.

Every objection now meets three walls at once: a challenge to the objector's motives, a correction of their facts, and a decision already taken without them. There is no angle left from which to disagree, because each route has been separately foreclosed.

One gift burns the institution, one walls off the reasoning, one severs the relationships. All three feel like integrity from the inside, and the resulting isolation gets read as confirmation rather than as symptom.

apex-visionary.tell: Watch the delegation, not the intensity. When this archetype stops handing off pieces of the design, the other two descents are already underway.

principled-reformer.name: The Unpaid Reckoning
principled-reformer.line: Someone doing the work of reform, keeping private count of who else showed up, and finally going quiet with the receipts.

missing.text: Encouragement is the missing brake. An Enthusiast keeps reform something people want to join rather than something they are being graded on — which is the difference between a movement and an indictment.

stages.text: The call for reform sharpens while the reformer quietly takes on more of the work and starts hedging every claim they cannot yet prove. The edge is visible. The load and the withheld judgment are not.

The critique turns personal, the ledger of who actually helped starts running, and precision turns punitive. Others feel prosecuted, indebted and corrected at once, so they stop volunteering — which the reformer reads as proof of the original diagnosis.
The work stops, the door closes, and the withdrawal itself becomes the final argument. They are left holding an accurate account of a broken thing and no relationship through which to fix it.

principled-reformer.tell: The sharpening is loud and the tallying is silent. Do not respond to the sharpening. Ask what they have been carrying that they have not mentioned.

scholarly-investor.name: The Closed Fund
scholarly-investor.line: Conviction that hardened into criteria, and criteria that hardened into a closed hand.

missing.text: Mercy is the missing brake. A Lover keeps the person on the other side of the decision visible as a person, which is precisely what disappears when everything becomes criteria.

stages.text: Discernment turns toward disqualification, diligence acquires one more round, and the resources begin to be measured rather than moved. Each step is defensible on its own; together they mean nothing gets funded.

Judgment about a proposal becomes judgment about the person making it, the bar moves whenever it is met, and what does get released carries conditions. People learn they are being assessed rather than backed.

The fund closes, the reasoning walls off, and the conviction burns whatever bridges remain. The stewardship language that was true at the start is still in use at the end, when it has stopped being true.

scholarly-investor.tell: Count decisions, not meetings. When the analysis is deepening and nothing has been released in a quarter, all three descents are running.

insightful-inspirer.name: The Brilliant Exit
insightful-inspirer.line: The insight gets sharper, the correction gets public, and then the room loses them entirely.

missing.text: Service is the missing brake. A Servant anchors the insight to work that has to be finished in place, and it is very hard to vanish from something you are still holding.

stages.text: The insight sharpens, the caveats multiply, and the delivery gets brighter to compensate for both. The room receives more energy and less substance, and cannot tell that anything is wrong.

The accusation, the public correction and the charm now arrive together and contradict each other. People cannot tell whether they are being taught, indicted or entertained, so they stop bringing anything real.

The bridges burn, the reasoning seals, and then the person is simply gone — usually with a story about outgrowing a place that was never going to understand. The story is convincing enough that even they believe it.

insightful-inspirer.tell: Rising energy alongside rising precision is the signature. When both climb at once, the exit is already being drafted.

compassionate-sage.name: The Wounded Authority
compassionate-sage.line: Truth told with increasing precision by someone increasingly certain it will not be received.

missing.text: Encouragement is the missing brake. An Enthusiast keeps the delivery warm enough to survive its own accuracy — this archetype's truth is usually correct and usually arrives at a temperature no one can receive.

stages.text: The truth-telling sharpens, the case gets qualified, and the room gets smoothed — often inside a single conversation. They say the hard thing, hedge it, then apologise for its temperature.
The indictment and the plea arrive together: an accusation with an ache underneath it, followed by an airtight justification for both. The listener has no idea which one they are meant to answer.
The fire, the wall and the silence combine into something that looks like disappearance and feels like grief. The truth was correct, the delivery was defended, and the person is no longer reachable.

compassionate-sage.tell: Listen for the apology attached to the hard thing. When this archetype starts softening the truth immediately after saying it, the descent has begun.

visionary-implementer.name: The Solitary Build
visionary-implementer.line: A better way, built at real personal cost, by someone who stopped asking for help and then stopped trusting it.

missing.text: Mercy is the missing brake. A Lover says the cost out loud while it is still a request rather than a grievance — this archetype's failure is almost always a conversation that happened eighteen months too late.

stages.text: Urgency rises, the work quietly consolidates into one pair of hands, and the plan's grip tightens. Each of those looks like commitment. Together they mean nobody else can help.
The accusation, the private ledger and the override run at once. Objections get steamrolled by someone who is also doing most of the labour, which makes the steamrolling nearly impossible to name.
They burn the arrangement down, break under the load, and freeze out anyone who tries to intervene. The exhaustion is read as evidence of how much it mattered rather than of a broken system.

visionary-implementer.tell: When the person doing the most work also stops asking for any, both outward descents are already at stage two.

resourced-revolutionary.name: The Funded Ultimatum
resourced-revolutionary.line: A cause genuinely worth backing, backed with strings, run by someone who has stopped consulting anyone.

missing.text: Service is the missing brake. A Servant keeps the work in contact with what it actually costs the people doing it — which is the information this archetype systematically stops receiving.

stages.text: The cause becomes non-negotiable, the funding starts being measured, and the decisions consolidate. A movement that was gathering people begins, very quietly, to become an administration.

Conviction, conditional money and unilateral authority combine into something close to coercion — sincerely meant. Nobody downstream can separate the mission's demands from this person's preferences, because they have merged.
The bridges burn, the hand closes, and the leadership goes cold. The revolution ends up organised exactly like the institution it was built to replace, run by someone who cannot see the resemblance.

resourced-revolutionary.tell: Watch for the first condition attached to money that used to be given freely. That is the earliest catchable moment.

galvanizing-leader.name: The Managed Movement
galvanizing-leader.line: A true call, smoothed for the crowd, then executed alone when the crowd does not hold.

missing.text: Teaching is the missing brake. An Erudite insists the message stay accurate under compression — this archetype's real risk is that the version everyone repeats is not quite the version that was true.

stages.text: The call sharpens, the delivery brightens, and the plan tightens. The room feels more inspired and has less room to move — a combination that produces enthusiastic compliance rather than genuine buy-in.
Moral pressure, managed messaging and overridden dissent operate together. Anyone raising a hard question meets conviction, then warmth, then a decision that had already been taken.
The movement is scorched, the leader disappears from the relationships that built it, and what remains is run coldly by one person. Everyone remembers the speeches and nobody remembers being asked.

galvanizing-leader.tell: When the message gets more compelling at the same rate it gets less specific, all three descents are underway.

protective-visionary.name: The Guarded Mandate
protective-visionary.line: Protecting people by deciding for them, until the protector is the loneliest person in the room.

missing.text: Teaching is the missing brake. An Erudite slows the certainty enough to ask whether the threat is still what it was — this archetype often keeps defending against a danger that passed some time ago.

stages.text: The threat sharpens, the grip tightens, and the person absorbs the resulting tension rather than naming it. Protection is being built, and its cost is being hidden by the same person building it.
They indict the danger, override the people they are protecting, then plead for understanding about having done so. The protected experience being decided for and then asked to be grateful.
The scorching, the freezing and the shutting down arrive close together, and the guardian ends up the most isolated person inside the arrangement they built for everyone else's safety.

protective-visionary.tell: The plea is the tell. When protective decisions start arriving with an account of how hard they were to make, stage two is here.

master-craftsman.name: The Standard No One Meets
master-craftsman.line: Excellent work absorbed without complaint, then defended as a standard, then kept from everyone.

missing.text: Encouragement is the missing brake. An Enthusiast makes a standard something people aspire to rather than something they fail — the same bar, received completely differently.

stages.text: The work quietly expands, the standards acquire caveats, and delegation stops. Nothing looks wrong — the output is excellent — so the load, the withheld judgment and the control all stay invisible.
The silent tally, the punitive correction and the override combine into a workplace where nobody's work is good enough and nobody is told why in time to fix it.
The collapse, the wall and the freeze happen together, and the knowledge goes with them. What is lost is not only a person but everything only that person knew how to do.

master-craftsman.tell: Ask who else could do this if they were away for a month. The answer is the diagnostic.

prudent-architect.name: The Conditional Plan
prudent-architect.line: A decision deferred, then priced, then made unilaterally when the deferral finally ran out.

missing.text: Prophecy is the missing brake. A Catalyst names the thing everyone is avoiding while there is still time to change course — this archetype's deferrals are usually protecting one unspoken disagreement.

stages.text: The recommendation acquires conditions, the resources acquire conditions, and the plan tightens around the resulting uncertainty. Three different forms of not-quite-committing, running at once.
Correction, leverage and override replace consultation. The decision gets made by whichever of the three moves first, and the reasoning behind it is never made available to anyone.
The reasoning seals, the hand closes, and the leadership goes cold. An architecture built to last outlives the trust of everyone who was supposed to live inside it.

prudent-architect.tell: Count the decisions waiting on one more piece of information. When that number stops falling, the descent has started.

engaging-mentor.name: The Curriculum Without a Student
engaging-mentor.line: Depth withheld until it is ready, packaged when it is not, then delivered to no one in particular.

missing.text: Mercy is the missing brake. A Lover notices which particular student stopped being reached — a signal that vanishes entirely once mentoring becomes a curriculum.

stages.text: The material is never quite ready, the delivery gets more energetic to cover the gap, and the mentoring tightens into a program. Depth withheld, warmth increased, structure imposed.
Public correction, spun reassurance and overridden objection produce a mentee who cannot tell whether they are doing well. They are praised, corrected and redirected in the same conversation.
The teacher seals, the warmth vanishes, and the system runs on without either. What remains is a curriculum administered by someone who has stopped noticing who is in the room.

engaging-mentor.tell: When the encouragement stops being specific to the person receiving it, all three have started.

wise-shepherd.name: The Silent Rod
wise-shepherd.line: Counsel held back, then a decision made over the top of it, then a shepherd who has gone quiet.

missing.text: Prophecy is the missing brake. A Catalyst makes the unspoken thing speakable before it calcifies — this archetype's crises are almost always things that were known and unsaid for a long time.

stages.text: The counsel is withheld pending certainty, the grip tightens, and the discomfort is absorbed instead of named. The flock meets a shepherd who is present, quieter, and less consultative.
Correction, override and plea run together: a decision made for their good, defended with reasoning, and accompanied by hurt that it was not received well.
The wall, the freeze and the silence combine. The shepherd is still there, still responsible, and no longer reachable by anyone — including the people who need them most.

wise-shepherd.tell: Watch for counsel that arrives after the decision rather than before it. That inversion is the earliest sign.

practical-revolutionary.name: The Withdrawn Alternative
practical-revolutionary.line: A tangible answer to what is broken, built alone, funded alone, and eventually taken back.

missing.text: Encouragement is the missing brake. An Enthusiast keeps people wanting to be part of the thing — without which the alternative has exactly one owner and therefore exactly one point of failure.

stages.text: The critique sharpens while the build quietly consolidates into one person's hands and the resources start being measured. Labour and money begin flowing from the same source, unasked.
Indictment, silent tally and conditional provision combine into an alternative that only one person can fund, only one person can build, and everyone else is somehow failing to deserve.
The burn, the collapse and the closed hand arrive together, and the alternative disappears with the person carrying it — leaving the broken thing it was replacing still standing.

practical-revolutionary.tell: When one person is supplying both the labour and the money and has stopped asking for either, it has begun.

faithful-steward.name: The Audited Gift
faithful-steward.line: Quiet faithfulness that becomes quiet accounting, and finally a closed hand with excellent records.

missing.text: Encouragement is the missing brake. An Enthusiast keeps gratitude circulating rather than accumulating — this archetype's collapse is almost always a decade of unacknowledged reliability.

stages.text: Work accumulates, judgment is withheld, and generosity begins to be measured. All three are silent. This is the most invisible strain in the system: there is genuinely nothing to see.
The ledger runs, the corrections sharpen, and the giving acquires terms. Still almost nothing surfaces, because none of these three gifts has any native mechanism for confrontation.
The collapse, the wall and the closed hand happen at once, and every route to this person closes in the same week — practical, intellectual and material. Nobody sees it coming, including them.

faithful-steward.tell: This one cannot be caught by watching. It can only be caught by asking, on a schedule, when nothing appears wrong.

joyful-benefactor.name: The Cheerful Depletion
joyful-benefactor.line: Giving past capacity with a smile on it, deflecting every offer of help, and then quietly shutting the door.

missing.text: Leadership is the missing brake. A Strategist sets the limit before the limit sets itself — this archetype has no native mechanism for a planned stop, only for an unplanned one.

stages.text: The load grows, the brightness grows with it, and the generosity starts being quietly rationed. The performance is convincing precisely because the warmth behind it is real.
The tally, the spin and the leverage run together. Offers of help get deflected with a joke, the giving develops strings nobody can name, and the cost stays invisible for another year.
The collapse, the vanishing and the closed hand arrive at once. To everyone else this is sudden. To them it has been coming for a decade.

joyful-benefactor.tell: Notice when a specific offer of help gets a cheerful non-answer. That deflection is the whole descent in miniature.

master-provider.name: The Provisioned Silence
master-provider.line: Everything supplied, conditions attached, and no one left who is able to say no.

missing.text: Mercy is the missing brake. A Lover keeps provision an act of care rather than a term of trade — and can tell the difference from the inside, which this archetype cannot.

stages.text: Needs get met before they are voiced, provision starts being measured, and the decisions consolidate. The household or team reorganises around a level of support nobody asked for and nobody can now question.
The silent ledger, the conditional provision and the override combine into an arrangement where disagreeing with the provider is indistinguishable from ingratitude.
The collapse, the closed hand and the freeze land together, and everyone downstream discovers at once how much was being carried and how little of it was ever discussable.

master-provider.tell: Ask whether anyone in this system has said no to them in the past year and had it stick.

tender-provider.name: The Quiet Cost
tender-provider.line: Care given until it hurts, then care given with a hook in it, and then nothing at all.

missing.text: Prophecy is the missing brake. A Catalyst makes the unspoken resentment sayable while it is still small — this archetype's entire failure mode is a true thing that was never once said out loud.

stages.text: The care expands, the resources start being counted, and the tension is absorbed rather than named. Nothing points outward; the entire strain is being paid privately.
The tally, the leverage and the plea braid together into care that has a hook in it and a hurt underneath it, neither of which is ever stated plainly.
The collapse, the closed hand and the silence arrive together. The most consistently generous person in the system stops completely, and cannot explain why in terms anyone finds proportionate.

tender-provider.tell: There is no visible tell. Ask what it cost them, specifically, and do not accept the first cheerful answer.

compassionate-agitator.name: The Burned Advocate
compassionate-agitator.line: A voice raised for people who are hurting, softened to keep the room, and then extinguished.

missing.text: Leadership is the missing brake. A Strategist converts outrage into something with a sequence and a stopping point — without it, this archetype's compassion has no container and burns at full rate until it is gone.

stages.text: The advocacy sharpens, the delivery brightens to keep the relationships alive, and the private cost is absorbed. Confrontation and warmth begin alternating, sometimes inside one conversation.
Indictment, spin and plea cycle unpredictably. People close to them get confrontation, then charm, then hurt, and cannot find a stable version of the person to respond to.
The scorch, the vanishing and the silence combine into a burnout that looks from outside like sudden indifference and is actually someone who ran at full rate until there was nothing left.

compassionate-agitator.tell: The oscillation itself is the tell. When confrontation and charm start alternating faster, the cycle is tightening.

devoted-caretaker.name: The Invisible Ledger
devoted-caretaker.line: Endless care, unfailing brightness, and a silence at the end that no one saw coming.

missing.text: Prophecy is the missing brake. A Catalyst says the true thing out loud years earlier — this archetype has no gift that generates confrontation, which is precisely why the ledger stays invisible until it closes.

stages.text: The care expands, the brightness holds, and the tension is absorbed. Three gifts, none of which point outward, all straining — which is exactly why nobody notices anything.
The tally runs, the mood stays light, and the hurt leaks sideways. The people benefiting most receive warmth, a faint sense that something is off, and no way to locate it.
The collapse, the vanishing and the silence happen together. The person who held everything is gone, and the household or team discovers all at once how much of it was them.

devoted-caretaker.tell: This archetype has no gift that generates confrontation. Nothing will surface on its own; the check has to be structural and scheduled.

affectionate-counselor.name: The Withheld Word
affectionate-counselor.line: The counsel that was never quite ready, the reassurance offered instead, and the counselor who went quiet.

missing.text: Leadership is the missing brake. A Strategist forces the decision the caring keeps deferring — this archetype knows the answer far earlier than it says it.

stages.text: The hard word is withheld, the warmth increases to fill its place, and the discomfort is absorbed. The counselee leaves feeling better and no wiser, and the counselor knows it.
Correction, spin and plea combine into counsel that arrives late, wrapped and hedged, followed by hurt when it is not acted on. Nobody involved can tell what was actually advised.
The seal, the vanishing and the silence land together, and the person most trusted with everyone's inner life becomes unreachable without ever having said a difficult sentence.

affectionate-counselor.tell: Watch for encouragement offered where an assessment was requested. That substitution is stage one.

lavish-celebrant.name: The Empty Table
lavish-celebrant.line: A feast thrown for everyone, subtly invoiced, by a host nobody thought to ask about.

missing.text: Teaching is the missing brake. An Erudite asks the honest question underneath the celebration — the one question this archetype's warmth is very good at preventing anyone from asking.

stages.text: The gatherings get bigger, the giving starts being counted, and the host absorbs whatever tension the room produces. The generosity is real and the arithmetic underneath it has already started.
The spin, the leverage and the plea run together. Hospitality acquires an unstated invoice and a faint undertow of hurt, and guests feel both without being able to name either.
The vanishing, the closed hand and the silence arrive at once. The person who filled every room they entered concludes that no one was ever coming for them, and stops opening the door.

lavish-celebrant.tell: Notice who asks this person how they are and does not accept 'wonderful.' If nobody does, the descent has no brake at all.

encouraging-shepherd.name: The Hollow Rally
encouraging-shepherd.line: Encouragement turned up, dissent rolled over, and a shepherd who no longer believes their own speech.

missing.text: Teaching is the missing brake. An Erudite checks whether the encouragement is still true — this archetype can sustain a message long past the point where it stopped being accurate.

stages.text: The encouragement intensifies, the plan tightens, and the doubt is absorbed rather than voiced. Morale becomes the metric while the gap between what is said and what is true begins to widen.
Spin, override and plea alternate. The person raising a hard question is encouraged, then handled, then made to feel they have wounded someone — often in that order and in one meeting.
The vanishing, the freeze and the silence combine. The shepherd who asked everyone to believe has stopped believing, and leaves a community that never once heard them say so.

encouraging-shepherd.tell: When the encouragement stops matching what people can see with their own eyes, stage one is over.

practical-pioneer.name: The Abandoned Prototype
practical-pioneer.line: A new thing built by hand, resented in private, and walked away from without warning.

missing.text: Leadership is the missing brake. A Strategist gives the work a horizon long enough to survive its hard middle — this archetype builds beautifully and has no native mechanism for finishing.

stages.text: Urgency sharpens, the build consolidates into one pair of hands, and the energy stays high. The prototype gets made, and the imbalance underneath it is invisible behind the enthusiasm.
Indictment, private tally and spin cycle unpredictably. The same person confronts, resents and reassures within a day, and colleagues cannot work out which one is the real position.

The burn, the collapse and the disappearance arrive together. Something genuinely new is abandoned at exactly the point where it needed a boring middle, and the exit is framed as needing a new challenge.

practical-pioneer.tell: When the person doing the hands-on work starts talking about what is next, the third descent has already begun.

compassionate-builder.name: The Unspoken Bill
compassionate-builder.line: Work done for people who are suffering, counted silently, and ended in silence.

missing.text: Giving is the missing brake. A Host resources the work so it does not have to be paid for out of the builder — this archetype consistently funds compassion with its own body.

stages.text: The wrong sharpens, the work consolidates, and the cost is absorbed silently. They are angry about the suffering, doing most of the work about it, and saying nothing about either.
The indictment, the ledger and the plea run at once. The people being served receive urgency, unspoken debt and hurt in the same interaction, and can only respond to one of the three.
The scorch, the collapse and the silence land together. Work that existed for suffering people ends because the person doing it was suffering and had no gift that would say so.

compassionate-builder.tell: This archetype confronts systems and never confronts people. Ask directly what they need; they will not volunteer it.

generous-pioneer.name: The Recalled Backing
generous-pioneer.line: A bold bet, sold hard, then pulled when the enthusiasm and the returns run out together.

missing.text: Teaching is the missing brake. An Erudite tests whether the bet is sound before it needs defending — this archetype's conviction and charm can carry a weak idea a very long way.

stages.text: The bet hardens into certainty, the pitch brightens, and the money starts being measured. Two gifts are selling while the third is quietly getting cold feet, and nobody hears about the third.

Indictment, spin and leverage combine. Doubters are challenged, difficulties reframed, and the funding acquires conditions — so the people who went all in are now managing the person who asked them to.
The burn, the vanishing and the closed hand arrive together. Support is withdrawn suddenly and framed as discipline, leaving people holding something they were told to commit to.

generous-pioneer.tell: Watch the gap between how confident the pitch is and how conditional the money has become. That gap is the descent.

resourced-healer.name: The Conditional Rescue
resourced-healer.line: Help offered urgently, then attached to terms, then withdrawn along with the helper.

missing.text: Leadership is the missing brake. A Strategist builds the help into something that runs without the healer's presence — otherwise every rescue depends on one person's ongoing goodwill.

stages.text: The need sharpens, the help starts being measured, and the helper absorbs whatever it costs. Intervention accelerates while the willingness to fund it quietly contracts.
Indictment, leverage and plea combine into help that arrives urgently, carries terms, and comes with an ache the recipient is somehow responsible for.
The scorch, the closed hand and the silence land together. The rescue and the rescuer are withdrawn at once, and the person being helped is left worse off than before it started.

resourced-healer.tell: When help starts requiring a particular response from the person receiving it, stage two has arrived.

meticulous-motivator.name: The Corrected Cheer
meticulous-motivator.line: Doing everything, correcting everyone, and then simply not being there.

missing.text: Leadership is the missing brake. A Strategist distributes the work before it consumes the person doing it — this archetype will carry an unsustainable load indefinitely without ever flagging it.

stages.text: The details accumulate, the standards acquire caveats, and the energy stays high. Everything runs beautifully, and the person running it is the only one who knows what that costs.
Tally, correction and spin run together: encouragement with an amendment attached, delivered by someone keeping a private account of what they are carrying.
The collapse, the seal and the vanishing arrive at once, and both the details and the morale go with them. The gap left behind is much larger than anyone had estimated.

meticulous-motivator.tell: When encouragement starts arriving with corrections attached, the accumulation underneath is already well advanced.

wise-caretaker.name: The Careful Withdrawal
wise-caretaker.line: Care given precisely, then defended precisely, then withdrawn without explanation.

missing.text: Encouragement is the missing brake. An Enthusiast keeps the relationship warm enough to hold a correction — without it, every piece of feedback in either direction costs more than it should.

stages.text: The care expands, the judgment is withheld, and the tension is absorbed. Three silent gifts, all straining, none of which will announce anything.
The tally, the precise correction and the plea combine into care that is thoughtful, faintly reproachful and quietly wounded — a combination almost impossible to respond to well.
The collapse, the wall and the silence land together, and the withdrawal is final, well-reasoned and unexplained. No one is given a reason, because giving one would mean asking for something.

wise-caretaker.tell: Watch for care that starts being defended rather than simply given. That shift is the earliest visible thing.

prudent-mentor.name: The Deferred Investment
prudent-mentor.line: A judgment never quite delivered, a reassurance offered instead, and support quietly discontinued.

missing.text: Prophecy is the missing brake. A Catalyst forces the honest verdict the prudence keeps postponing — this archetype's kindness reliably delays the one conversation that would have helped.

stages.text: The verdict is withheld, the warmth increases, and the investment starts being measured. The mentee is being encouraged and quietly reassessed at the same time, and is told about only one of those.
Correction, spin and leverage produce a relationship in which support is conditional on something that has never been stated. The mentee is being tested against a bar they have not been shown.
The seal, the vanishing and the withdrawn support arrive together. The person on the other end never learns what the actual judgment was, which is the specific cruelty of this one.

prudent-mentor.tell: Ask this archetype to say the verdict plainly. How hard it is to get a plain answer is the measurement.

benevolent-counselor.name: The Priced Confidence
benevolent-counselor.line: Wisdom held back, help given with terms, and a counselor who stopped answering.

missing.text: Prophecy is the missing brake. A Catalyst names the dynamic while both parties can still hear it — this archetype tends to fund what it should have confronted.

stages.text: The counsel is withheld, the help starts being measured, and the discomfort is absorbed. Wisdom, resources and feeling all present, all held back, none announced.
Correction, leverage and plea combine: help that carries terms, advice too carefully worded to act on, and hurt that neither party can locate the source of.
The seal, the closed hand and the silence land together. They stop returning the call, and the person who needed them has no idea which of the three things they did wrong.

benevolent-counselor.tell: When money or practical help starts substituting for the conversation, the descent is underway.

inspirational-implementer.name: The Overloaded Engine
inspirational-implementer.line: Carrying it all, keeping morale up about it, and finally running it alone in silence.

missing.text: Mercy is the missing brake. A Lover registers what the carrying is costing before it hardens — this archetype's own reporting on its own state is systematically unreliable.

stages.text: The execution consolidates, the morale stays high, and the plan tightens. The team is encouraged, the work is being absorbed by one person, and the reporting has quietly stopped being accurate.
Tally, spin and override run together. The mood in the room and the state of the work diverge, and the person maintaining both is the only one who can see the gap.
The collapse, the vanishing and the freeze arrive at once. The engine that carried the operation stops, and everyone discovers simultaneously that there was no second engine.

inspirational-implementer.tell: Compare their report on their own capacity with the volume they are actually carrying. The divergence is the measurement.

protective-architect.name: The Fortified Care
protective-architect.line: Protection built by hand, imposed without consent, and then abandoned in hurt.

missing.text: Encouragement is the missing brake. An Enthusiast keeps the protected people feeling chosen rather than managed — the same safeguards, received as care instead of as control.

stages.text: The safeguards get built quietly, the grip tightens, and the cost is absorbed. Protection is being constructed by someone who will not mention constructing it.
The ledger, the override and the plea combine into protection imposed without consent, followed by hurt that it was not appreciated. The protected feel managed, and then guilty.
The collapse, the freeze and the silence land together. The structure stays standing and its keeper is gone, and the people inside it never knew it was held up by one person.

protective-architect.tell: Watch for a safeguard put in place without anyone being asked. That first unilateral protection is stage two arriving early.

kingdom-cultivator.name: The Managed Garden
kingdom-cultivator.line: A community grown warmly, resourced conditionally, and finally governed by one person alone.

missing.text: Mercy is the missing brake. A Lover knows which specific person in the community has stopped flourishing — a signal that disappears the moment community health becomes an aggregate.

stages.text: The gathering intensifies, the resources start being measured, and governance tightens. A community that felt like a family begins, imperceptibly, to become an organisation.
Spin, leverage and override combine. Belonging becomes conditional on terms that are never published, and warmth becomes the medium through which decisions are delivered rather than made.
The vanishing, the closed hand and the freeze arrive together. The garden is governed by one person who is no longer in it, and the people who joined for the warmth leave without a stated reason.

kingdom-cultivator.tell: When you can no longer tell whether an invitation is hospitality or strategy, stage two has started.

benevolent-leader.name: The Measured Mercy
benevolent-leader.line: Generosity that starts counting, leadership that stops asking, and compassion that closes the door.

missing.text: Prophecy is the missing brake. A Catalyst says the thing the kindness is protecting everyone from — this archetype's decline is almost entirely composed of unsaid true things.

stages.text: The generosity starts being weighed, the plan tightens, and the resulting friction is absorbed rather than named. Provision, authority and feeling all contracting quietly at once.
Leverage, override and plea combine into leadership that gives conditionally, decides unilaterally, and is wounded that neither is received warmly. Nobody can respond to all three.

The closed hand, the freeze and the silence land together. The most generous person in the organisation stops giving, stops consulting and stops speaking, in roughly that order and without explanation.

benevolent-leader.tell: Notice the first time generosity is mentioned rather than simply given. Naming it is the beginning of counting it.

amplifying.name: Amplifying
amplifying.body: Two of the three gifts point their distress at people, and they do not take turns — they compound. Each makes the other's pressure feel justified, so escalation is fast and the person experiences it as decisiveness.
amplifying.visibility: Visible early and from a distance. Everyone around them can see it. They cannot.
amplifying.catch: Ask them to name one person currently allowed to tell them no. If the answer takes a moment, it has started.

hardening.name: Hardening
hardening.mix: One outward edge over a silent accumulation
hardening.body: One gift pushes outward while two bank in silence. The visible edge is the smallest part of what is happening: behind it, work, resources or certainty are being accumulated and quietly withdrawn.
hardening.visibility: People react to the edge and miss the accumulation, so the help aims at the wrong thing while the real problem keeps growing.
hardening.catch: Do not respond to the sharpness. Ask what they have been carrying that they have not mentioned.

rotating.name: Rotating
rotating.mix: One of each — outward, silent, concealed
rotating.body: One gift presses, one holds, one hides. Under pressure this archetype does not have a single failure mode; it has three, and which appears depends on who is in the room and what the moment permits.
rotating.visibility: Inconsistent from outside. Different people describe their distress completely differently, and all of them are right.
rotating.catch: Compare notes with someone who sees them in a different setting. Neither of you has the whole picture alone.

oscillating.name: Oscillating
oscillating.body: One gift pushes outward and two conceal. The result is alternation: a period of confrontation followed by a period of warmth or absence, with no stable middle.
oscillating.visibility: Whichever state you respond to, the other is coming — which makes them very hard to help, because help aimed at one phase arrives during the other.
oscillating.catch: Respond to the pattern, not the phase. Name the oscillation itself, gently, while things are calm.

silent-drift.name: Silent Drift
silent-drift.mix: Two silent, one concealed — nothing aims outward
silent-drift.body: Nothing in this archetype's distress aims at anyone. Two gifts accumulate quietly and the third conceals what is accumulating. There is no confrontation phase to alert anybody.
silent-drift.visibility: Everything appears fine for a long time, then something ends without warning. The people closest are the most surprised.
silent-drift.catch: It cannot be caught by watching. Ask directly and repeatedly, on a schedule, when nothing appears wrong.

vanishing.name: Vanishing
vanishing.body: Two gifts conceal and one accumulates. The concealment is not deception — it is the gift working: warmth offered, tension absorbed, the room kept comfortable while the cost is paid privately.
vanishing.visibility: The most beloved person in the room disappears, and nobody can point to when it started.
vanishing.catch: Ask what it cost them, specifically, and do not accept a cheerful answer the first time.

sealing.name: Sealing
sealing.body: All three gifts accumulate and none of them announce it. Work banked, resources banked, judgment banked — and each closes a different exit when it finally closes.
sealing.visibility: The most invisible descent in the system. There is genuinely nothing to see until every door shuts at once.
sealing.catch: Only structural help works: a standing, scheduled question from someone with permission to ask it. Nothing spontaneous will surface this.
